description: Fetch the full official .ds2 source code, syntax notes, and metadata for a single starter example by id (equivalent aliases: exampleId, filename, key, name, example; id takes precedence) and optional lang ('ko', 'en', 'de', 'ja'). Missing or unknown id returns a validation error listing valid example IDs. Use after dsdx.examples.list when you need runnable DS2 code for /play or local editing; use dsdx.examples.list instead when browsing available examples. Omitting id on public /mcp returns default ds2/v2 starter example 'st-conditions-v2' with fallback=true.

aspectPreset.description: Optional 3D Build Show viewport preset when buildShow is true: 'landscape-16x9' | 'shorts-9x16' | 'square-1x1'

bpm.description: Timeline tempo BPM when buildShow is true (40..220, default: 140.0)

buildShow.description: When true, generate a self-contained 3D Build Show + AAS offline viewer resourceUri for this official example

buildShowOptions.description: Optional dsdx-build-show/1.0 configuration object when buildShow is true

cleanShortsMode.description: Hide all chrome in ?shorts=1 mode when buildShow is true (default: true)

durationSeconds.description: Build Show timeline duration in seconds when buildShow is true (3..300, default: 32.0)

height.description: Canvas height in pixels when buildShow is true (180..3840)

id.description: Official example id or filename, e.g. 'basic', 'tutorial-basic', 'intermediate', 'xg5000-demo-kit', 'advanced', 'library-advanced', 'carwash', 'carwash-continuous', 'st-conditions-v2', 'robot-assembly-cell-v2', 'status-indicator-cell-v2'

includeHtml.description: Whether to inline UTF-8 HTML text in artifacts when buildShow is true (default: false)

subPartAssembly.description: Animate sub-part assembly sequence when buildShow is true (default: true)

width.description: Canvas width in pixels when buildShow is true (320..3840)

name: dsdx.examples.get

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
